{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species and print the results
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('Mean flipper length by species:')
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find and print the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')
print(f'Mean flipper length: {highest_mean_value:.2f} mm')"}
